title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams

fields.name: auto_retry_requests
fields.description: Immediately retry failed requests to AWS services once. This option doesn't affect the normal Fluent Bit retry mechanism with backoff. Instead, it enables an immediate retry with no delay for networking errors, which might help improve throughput when there are transient/random networking issues.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Specify a custom endpoint for the Kinesis API.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: Specify an external ID for the STS API. You can use this option with the role_arn parameter if your role requires an external ID.

fields.name: log_key
fields.description: By default, the whole log record will be sent to Kinesis. If you specify a key name with this option, then only the value of that key will be sent to Kinesis. For example, if you are using the Fluentd Docker log driver, you can specify log_key log and only the log message will be sent to Kinesis.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the Kinesis Streams service.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region. China regions (cn-north-1, cn-northwest-1) and the AWS European Sovereign Cloud region (eusc-de-east-1) are supported; Fluent Bit automatically uses the correct endpoint suffix (.amazonaws.com.cn or .amazonaws.eu) and no custom endpoint is required.

fields.name: role_arn
fields.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume (for cross-account access).

fields.name: simple_aggregation
fields.description: Enable record aggregation to combine multiple records into single API calls. This reduces the number of requests and can improve throughput.

fields.name: stream
fields.description: The name of the Kinesis stream that you want log records sent to.

fields.name: sts_endpoint
fields.description: Custom endpoint for the STS API.

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: Add the timestamp to the record under this key.

fields.name: time_key_format
fields.description: The strftime compliant format string for the timestamp. Supports millisecond precision with %3N and supports nanosecond precision with %9N and %L. For example, adding %3N to support millisecond %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N. This option is used with time_key.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.
